guide.title: Start here
guide.body:
Your game lives in Assets/_Project.

Features/Sample is a feature module: copy the folder, rename Sample in its files and asmdefs, and add its installer to App/Game/GameInstaller.cs between the cmpose:features markers.

README.md covers builds, signing and deep links.
